name: CompTIA Network+
note: Objective numbers and domain weights follow CompTIA's published outline for N10-009. Titles here are short summaries. Patch Notes isn't affiliated with CompTIA, uses no real exam questions, and practising here is preparation, not a guarantee of passing.

objectives.title: Network appliances, applications and functions
objectives.gap: Load balancers, proxies, IDS/IPS, NAS/SAN, CDN and QoS aren't covered in depth yet.

objectives.title: Cloud concepts and connectivity
objectives.gap: The lesson covers cloud security; VPCs, cloud gateways and connectivity options aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Ports, protocols, services and traffic types
objectives.gap: Unicast, multicast, anycast and broadcast aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Transmission media and transceivers
objectives.gap: Copper, fibre, wireless standards and transceivers aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Modern network environments
objectives.gap: SDN, SD-WAN, VXLAN, zero trust, SASE, infrastructure as code and IPv6 aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Routing technologies
objectives.gap: Static vs dynamic routing, OSPF/BGP/EIGRP, route selection and NAT details aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Switching technologies and features
objectives.gap: VLANs, trunking (802.1Q), spanning tree and MTU aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Wireless devices and technologies
objectives.gap: Wi-Fi standards, channels, frequencies, SSIDs and wireless encryption aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Physical installations
objectives.gap: Rack, power and environmental factors aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Organisational processes and procedures
objectives.gap: Documentation, change management and life-cycle management aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Network monitoring technologies
objectives.gap: SNMP, flow data and baselines aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Disaster recovery concepts
objectives.gap: RPO, RTO, MTTR, MTBF and site types (hot, warm, cold) aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: IPv4 and IPv6 network services
objectives.gap: DHCP and DNS basics are covered; NTP, SLAAC and DNS record types aren't yet.

objectives.title: Network access and management methods
objectives.gap: Site-to-site vs client VPN, jump boxes and in-band vs out-of-band management aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Basic network security concepts
objectives.gap: The CIA triad, PKI details, RADIUS/TACACS+/LDAP and compliance aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Attack types and their impact
objectives.gap: SYN floods are covered hands-on; VLAN hopping, MAC flooding, ARP and DNS poisoning and evil twins aren't yet.

objectives.title: Network security features, defences and solutions
objectives.gap: Port security, NAC, ACLs and screened subnets aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Troubleshooting methodology
objectives.gap: The DHCP challenge practises it; the full step-by-step method isn't taught on its own yet.

objectives.title: Cabling and physical interface issues
objectives.gap: Cable faults, interface errors and PoE issues aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Network service issues
objectives.gap: DHCP and DNS failures are covered; VLAN and routing faults aren't yet.

objectives.title: Performance issues
objectives.gap: Congestion, latency, jitter, packet loss and wireless interference aren't covered yet.

objectives.title: Tools and protocols for troubleshooting
objectives.gap: ping, traceroute and nslookup are practised in Network detective; tcpdump, Wireshark and nmap aren't yet.
